system_v1.notes: Adapts agent/loop.py's SYSTEM_PROMPT citation/hedging rules for structured JSON output produced after an agentic tool-calling phase (see DESIGN.md section 7).

system_v2.notes: Fixes v1's over-abstention: stage1-validation run showed 100% citation/grounding accuracy but only 20% (2/10) of genuinely-answerable questions were actually answered — the model said has_sufficient_context=false despite having on-topic retrieved chunks, on 8/10. v2 explicitly tells the model that synthesis across a chunk or two is not a reason to abstain, and narrows abstention to 'nothing on-topic was retrieved.'

system_v3.notes: Short reader prompt for the explicitly-built final call (generate.py's build_final_messages): the passages are placed in the user message as a labelled CONTEXT block, so this prompt says nothing about tools. Kept short on purpose — v1/v2 cost ~350-450 tokens of a 1024-token context. Not for the agentic tool-calling rounds; those still use system_v1.
